resetAsk.title: Reset progress?
resetAsk.text: All creatures, coins, berries, records and your streak will be erased from this device. There is no cloud save, so the progress cannot be brought back. Paid purchases return through the store.

resetSure.title: Erase everything?
resetSure.text: This is the last step. The progress is lost for good and the game starts as on the very first launch.

consent.title: A free game
consent.text: Tippy Treats is free thanks to ads. Next, your phone will ask whether the app may track your activity across other apps and websites. If you allow it, ads will suit you better. If you refuse, the game stays free, with less tailored ads.

soundboard.title: Soundboard
soundboard.allHint: Drop, perfect bell, coin, ability, collapse slaps and the music (the track last chosen below, «A Cup of Tea» at first) together.
soundboard.comboRunHint: Starts the chosen track and plays a run of drops with a perfect combo 1 to 12 over it, then a coin: how the bell ladder sits on the music.

sound.drop: A regular layer lands on the tower.
sound.perfect: A perfect drop. The bell climbs the ladder with the combo (shown: step 1, 6, 12).
sound.bite: The edge of a layer that overhangs the tower is bitten off.
sound.miss: The layer misses the tower: a falling whistle and a boom.
sound.collapseThud: One slap of the collapsing tower; later slaps are quieter (shown: first, 6th, 21st).
sound.topperHop: A topper hops off when the next layer lands.
sound.squeak: A creature squeaks on the home screen; every creature has its own pitch (shown: low, base, high).
sound.sneeze: A creature sneezes: a comic squeak down and a puff.
sound.ability: A creature ability fires; its own tune for each rarity.
sound.rainbowChime: The Rainbow layer flies in, and the level 5 transformation.
sound.rainbowJoke: The star of the Rainbow layer pops a small rainbow.
sound.cloudPuff: The cream cloud of the rainbow deflates.
sound.shieldPop: The brownie's shield bursts and eats a miss.
sound.lickSlurp: A layer licks a drop of glaze in one stroke (short lick).
sound.lickSlurpLong: The tongue goes round the whole face (long lick).
sound.lickSmack: The tongue snaps back into the mouth.
sound.lickHum: The licked layer is happy: a contented mmm.
sound.guestSplat: A layer lands on the fly guest: a heavy wet splat.
sound.guestPeel: The flattened guest peels off the layer.
sound.guestBuzz: The guest staggers away, offended: a rattling buzz.
sound.guestGiggle: A neighbour layer giggles at the guest.
sound.record: New record on the results screen and in the level-up panel. Turns the music down while it plays.
sound.recordBlip: The run crosses the session record.
sound.cutStretch: A cut piece lets go and the glaze strands start to pull: a short stretchy rise.
sound.cutStrandSnap: One glaze strand snaps; each snap is a little different in pitch.
sound.cutDrip: The drop of glaze falls off the cut: a small drip.
sound.cutPanic: The cut piece panics: a short comic squeak down, quieter than the sneeze.
sound.topperSquash: A layer squashes a topper (shown: each kind). Cream is the roller squeeze: quiet and longer.
sound.lickSlurpJuice: A layer licks a juice stain: the short slurp, shorter and quieter.
sound.snowPuff: A layer lands on a snow cap: a soft puff.
sound.thunder: Thunder after a flash, 150 to 400 ms late, with a low roll. Behind glass (window of the Kitchen and the Showcase) it is muffled.
sound.startleOh: The layers startle at lightning: one short "oh" per wave.
sound.yawn: A sleepy layer yawns at night: a quiet slow yawn.
sound.weatherBed: Rain, storm and snow wind bed (a few seconds here). For the owner to decide: off in the game; the minimal effects level never plays it.
sound.zoneChange: A new zone: a soft sweep and three rising notes.
sound.lapChange: A new lap of Space: four quick notes up to a high ringing one.
sound.countdownTick: A tick of the Continue countdown, higher on the last two seconds.
sound.purchase: A purchase or the starter pack went through: the coin ding and the berry chord.
